evidence.observation: Path filters include docs/**, scripts/docs/**, mkdocs.yml, and .github/workflows/docs.yml, but not .github/workflows/**. Adding dashboard-first-window-noscroll.yml did not run inventory parity.

findings.expected: A scheduled or path-triggered job fails when the published workflow inventory diverges from live YAML.
findings.actual: Inventory parity runs only on docs-path PRs.
findings.impact: Recurring catalog drift between docs PRs (same class as closed #9114 before freshness was scheduled).
findings.root_cause: docs.yml path filters omit workflow YAML glob.
findings.remediation: Add .github/workflows/** to docs.yml path filters. Out of this cycle file SCOPE (README.md docs/).
